scientific_integrity: Complete proof with explicit coefficient identities, orbit conjugators, degeneration families, tangent-space computation, and reproducible small-field tests; finite enumeration does not substitute for general arguments.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only two generators truncated at second powers in characteristic two, ordinary derivations, and the reduced/full idempotent derivation scheme; no higher-variable or odd-characteristic extension is asserted. Historical priority is provisional; independent validation has not occurred.
title: A smooth toral-derivation fourfold for the characteristic-two biquadratic algebra
